head.title: Acme Fit: Q3 launch review deck
head.subtitle: Five slides for the Q3 launch review of the Acme Fit apps, with speaker notes. Comment on any slide, press Present to rehearse, then approve the deck or request changes.
head.tldr: A five-slide hi-fi deck in the plain kit and the Indigo theme: the title, what shipped and what moved, weekly actives, a member quote and the Q4 ask. Four slides carry speaker notes; Present plays them in order.

sections.title: Brief
sections.lead: The product lead presents the Q3 launch of Acme Fit to the leadership team in twenty minutes.

sections.title: Slides
sections.lead: Five 16:9 slides in one row, in the order Present plays them.

03f05d7bc03d32bb.md:
- **Audience:** the Acme leadership team, on the boardroom screen and on laptops afterwards.
- **Story:** what shipped, what it moved, one member's voice, then the Q4 ask.
- **One point per slide,** large enough to read from the back of the room.

items.text: Which framework do the slides use?
items.sub: Recommend the plain kit: its slide classes ship with bluedoc, so the deck needs nothing installed.
Recommend Indigo: it matches the Acme Fit apps the deck reports on.

artboards.title: Title: Acme Fit, Q3 launch review
artboards.notes:
Welcome everyone. In twenty minutes: what we shipped in Q3, what it moved, and what we need for Q4.

Questions at the end, please; the numbers are in the appendix we send afterwards.

artboards.title: What shipped and what moved
artboards.notes:
Three launches this quarter: the watch app, passkey sign-in and weekly streaks.

- Passkeys halved the time to sign in.
- Streaks are the reason members come back in week 4.

artboards.title: Weekly actives
artboards.notes: This is the number to remember: **41,800** members active every week, up from 19,900 in June. The watch app accounts for most of the jump.

artboards.title: The Q4 ask
artboards.notes: The ask: two engineers for Android Wear and a coach dashboard by December. Decide today and we start on the 20th.
